import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
class Item { const Item(this.id); final String? id; }
class P extends StatelessWidget {
 const P({required this.items}); final List<Item> items;
 @override Widget build(BuildContext context)=>GridView.builder(
  primary:false,
  gridDelegate:const SliverGridDelegateWithFixedCrossAxisCount(crossAxisCount:2,mainAxisExtent:40),
  itemCount:items.length,
  itemBuilder:(_,index)=>Text(items[index].id??'nil',key:ValueKey<String?>(items[index].id)),
  findChildIndexCallback:(key)=>items.indexWhere((item)=>item.id==(key as ValueKey<String?>).value));
}
